description: Remaining sats and the hourly buy limit. maxBuysPerHour and remainingBuysHour are on this result. Do not call this before buying. A paid top-up is credited from the payment event. session_budget_sats sets the session cap up to the saved limit. reset_session starts a new session within that saved limit. Set issue_link_code only when the human asks for a one-time sign-in code. When Lightning payments are temporarily paused, the result includes paymentsPaused and retryAfter.

issue_link_code.description: Set true only when the human wants a one-time code to attach this balance to another Amazap sign-in. Leave unset for a normal balance check.

reset_session.description: Start a new session. Clears this session spend and restores the session cap to the saved account limit. It does not raise that limit or the daily limit.

session_budget_sats.description: Set the session cap to this many sats, up to the account saved limit. A higher number is refused and nothing changes. A lower cap can be raised again up to that saved limit. (minimum 1).

name: balance

outputSchema.description: The same object as the text JSON. code is set when the call stopped before delivery.

approvalUrl.description: Page where the person approves this exact price.

results.description: Search rows when this is a search result.

which.description: per_call, per_day, per_session, per_hour_buys, per_minute_calls, or per_minute_sats.
